title: Stage01Output
description: Schema for the structured output produced by Stage 01. Replace the fields below with your stage's actual output shape. If Stage 01 produces Markdown instead of JSON, delete this file.

id.description: Unique identifier for this run's output (e.g. ISO timestamp or slug).

status.description: Indicates whether the stage completed successfully or requires human attention before Stage 02 proceeds.

items.description: The primary output items produced by this stage.

label.description: Short identifier or category for this item.

content.description: The substantive output for this item.

confidence.description: Optional: AI's self-assessed confidence in this item. Low confidence items should be flagged for human review.

metadata.description: Run-level context recorded alongside the output.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this output was generated.

input_source.description: Name or path of the input file or resource this stage processed.

notes.description: Optional: free-text notes added by the AI or the human reviewer.
